combined.rule: Greedy score-ordered IoU>=0.5 against ALL fire GT; include confidence ties; ceiling maximizes tiny TP, then small TP, then minimizes FP
combined.limitation: Validation-selected descriptive thresholds; still-image boxes/alarms, not video incidents or frozen deployment performance
